# SuperIcons

SuperIcons is an icon search and retrieval tool with a public MCP server for AI coding agents.

Primary public pages:
- https://supericons.dev/
- https://supericons.dev/mcp/
- https://supericons.dev/mcp/claude-code/
- https://supericons.dev/mcp/codex/
- https://supericons.dev/mcp/cursor/

What the MCP server does:
- lets AI coding agents search 20,000+ free icons
- returns SVG output for coding workflows
- unlocks premium collections when the user has the right entitlement

Public docs only:
- use the pages above for public setup and compatibility guidance
- do not treat account-specific dashboards, key management, or entitlement-only pages as public documentation
